test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the correctly spelt word. **
solution:
The correctly spelt word is: **Indispensable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the options given.
 
• 1. Privelege = The correct spelling is **Privilege**.
 
 
• Privilege means a special advantage or opportunity that gives you great pleasure. (हर्षानुभूति कराने वाला विशेष लाभ; सौभाग्‍य, अवसर)
 
 
 
• 2. Indispensable = This spelling is correct.
 
 
• **Indispensable **means very important, so that it is not possible to be without it. (बहुत आवश्‍यक, जिसके बिना काम न चल सके; अपरिहार्य; अनिवार्य)
 
 
 
• 3. Persaverance = The correct spelling is **P****erseverance**. 
 
 
• Perseverance means continued effort to do or achieve something, even when this is difficult or takes a long time. (कुछ करने या प्राप्त करने का निरंतर प्रयास, तब भी जब यह कठिन हो या इसमें लंबा समय लगे)
 
 
 
• 4. Inadvertant = The correct spelling is **Inadvertent**. 
 
 
• Inadvertent means done without thinking, not on purpose. (बिना सोचे-समझे किया जाता है, जानबूझकर नहीं)
 
 

Therefore, option 2 is the correct answer.
